26    public function onFlush(OnFlushEventArgs $args): void
27    {
28        $em = $args->getObjectManager();
29        $uow = $em->getUnitOfWork();
30
31        foreach ($uow->getScheduledEntityInsertions() as $entity) {
32            if ($this->shouldLog($entity)) {
33                /** @var TenantAwareInterface $entity */
34                $auditLog = $this->logChange(
35                    $em,
36                    $entity,
37                    'INSERT',
38                    null,
39                    null,
40                    $this->getEntitySnapshot($em, $entity),
41                );
42                $this->insertedEntities[spl_object_hash($entity)] = $auditLog;
43            }
44        }
45
46        foreach ($uow->getScheduledEntityUpdates() as $entity) {
47            if ($this->shouldLog($entity)) {
48                assert($entity instanceof TenantAwareInterface);
49                $changeSet = $uow->getEntityChangeSet($entity);
50                $filteredChangeSet = $this->filterChangeSet($changeSet, $entity);
51
52                if ([] !== $filteredChangeSet) {
53                    $this->logChange($em, $entity, 'UPDATE', $filteredChangeSet);
54                }
55            }
56        }
57
58        foreach ($uow->getScheduledEntityDeletions() as $entity) {
59            if ($this->shouldLog($entity)) {
60                assert($entity instanceof TenantAwareInterface);
61                $this->logChange(
62                    $em,
63                    $entity,
64                    'REMOVE',
65                    null,
66                    $this->getEntitySnapshot($em, $entity),
67                    null,
68                );
69            }
70        }
71    }

73    public function postPersist(PostPersistEventArgs $args): void
74    {
75        $entity = $args->getObject();
76        $hash = spl_object_hash($entity);
77
78        if (isset($this->insertedEntities[$hash])) {
79            $auditLog = $this->insertedEntities[$hash];
80
81            if (method_exists($entity, 'getId')) {
82                $entityId = $entity->getId();
83                $auditLog->setEntityId($entityId);
84
85                // Update snapshotAfter with ID if it exists
86                $snapshotAfter = $auditLog->getSnapshotAfter();
87                if (null !== $snapshotAfter && array_key_exists('id', $snapshotAfter)) {
88                    $snapshotAfter['id'] = $entityId;
89                    $auditLog->setSnapshotAfter($snapshotAfter);
90                }
91
92                // If the AuditLog was already persisted (inserted in DB),
93                // we need to update it manually as it's too late for the unit of work to pick it up for a new insert.
94                if (null !== $auditLog->getId()) {
95                    $em = $args->getObjectManager();
96
97                    // Also check for owner ID if it wasn't set (e.g. cascaded persist)
98                    $ownerEntityId = $auditLog->getOwnerEntityId();
99                    $ownerEntityType = $auditLog->getOwnerEntityType();
100
101                    // If owner ID is missing, try to resolve it again
102                    if (null === $ownerEntityId) {
103                        if (method_exists($entity, 'getContact')) {
104                            $contact = $entity->getContact();
105                            if (is_object($contact) && method_exists($contact, 'getId')) {
106                                $ownerEntityId = $contact->getId();
107                                if (null !== $ownerEntityId) {
108                                    $auditLog->setOwnerEntityId($ownerEntityId);
109                                    if (null === $ownerEntityType) {
110                                        $ownerEntityType = ClassUtils::getClass($contact);
111                                        $auditLog->setOwnerEntityType($ownerEntityType);
112                                    }
113                                }
114                            }
115                        }
116                    }
117
118                    $em->getConnection()->executeStatement(
119                        'UPDATE audit_log SET entity_id = ?, owner_entity_id = ?, ' .
120                        'owner_entity_type = ?, snapshot_after = ? WHERE id = ?',
121                        [
122                            $entityId,
123                            $ownerEntityId,

125                            json_encode($this->maskSensitiveData($auditLog->getSnapshotAfter())),
126                            $auditLog->getId(),

128                    );
129                }
130            }
131
132            unset($this->insertedEntities[$hash]);

157    /**
158     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $changes
159     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $snapshotBefore
160     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $snapshotAfter
161     */
162    private function logChange(
163        EntityManagerInterface $em,
164        TenantAwareInterface $entity,
165        string $action,
166        ?array $changes,
167        ?array $snapshotBefore = null,
168        ?array $snapshotAfter = null,
169    ): AuditLog {
170        $auditLog = $this->createAuditLogEntity(
171            $entity,
172            $action,
173            $this->maskSensitiveData($changes),
174            $this->maskSensitiveData($snapshotBefore),
175            $this->maskSensitiveData($snapshotAfter)
176        );
177
178        $em->persist($auditLog);
179        $uow = $em->getUnitOfWork();
180        $uow->computeChangeSet($em->getClassMetadata(AuditLog::class), $auditLog);
181
182        return $auditLog;
183    }

185    /**
186     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $changes
187     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $snapshotBefore
188     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $snapshotAfter
189     */
190    private function createAuditLogEntity(
191        TenantAwareInterface $entity,
192        string $action,
193        ?array $changes,
194        ?array $snapshotBefore = null,
195        ?array $snapshotAfter = null,
196    ): AuditLog {
197        $auditLog = new AuditLog();
198        $auditLog->setEntityType(ClassUtils::getClass($entity));
199
200        // Set tenant from the entity being audited
201        $auditLog->setTenant($entity->getTenant());
202
203        $entityId = null;
204        if (method_exists($entity, 'getId')) {
205            $entityId = $entity->getId();
206        }
207        $auditLog->setEntityId($entityId);
208
209        if (method_exists($entity, 'getContact')) {
210            $contact = $entity->getContact();
211            if (is_object($contact) && method_exists($contact, 'getId')) {
212                $auditLog->setOwnerEntityType(ClassUtils::getClass($contact));
213                $auditLog->setOwnerEntityId($contact->getId());
214            }
215        }
216
217        $auditLog->setAction($action);
218        $auditLog->setChanges($changes); // Already masked in logChange
219        $auditLog->setSnapshotBefore($snapshotBefore); // Already masked in logChange
220        $auditLog->setSnapshotAfter($snapshotAfter); // Already masked in logChange
221
222        $user = $this->security->getUser();
223
224        if ($user instanceof User) {
225            $auditLog->setUser($user);
226        } elseif (null !== $entity->getTenant()) {
227            // Fallback to tenant if no user in security context (e.g. CLI or background task)
228            $auditLog->setUser($entity->getTenant());
229        }
230
231        return $auditLog;
232    }

234    /**
235     * @return array<string, mixed>
236     */
237    private function getEntitySnapshot(EntityManagerInterface $em, object $entity): array
238    {
239        $metadata = $em->getClassMetadata($entity::class);
240        $snapshot = [];
241
242        foreach ($metadata->getFieldNames() as $fieldName) {
243            $value = $metadata->getFieldValue($entity, $fieldName);
244
245            if (
246                $entity instanceof \App\Entity\ContactDate
247                && 'date' === $fieldName
248                && $value instanceof \DateTimeInterface
249            ) {
250                // For ContactDate, we only care about the date part (Y-m-d)
251                $snapshot[$fieldName] = $value->format('Y-m-d');
252            } else {
253                $snapshot[$fieldName] = $value;
254            }
255        }
256
257        foreach ($metadata->getAssociationNames() as $assocName) {
258            if ($metadata->isSingleValuedAssociation($assocName)) {
259                $associatedEntity = $metadata->getFieldValue($entity, $assocName);
260                if (is_object($associatedEntity) && method_exists($associatedEntity, 'getId')) {
261                    $snapshot[$assocName] = $associatedEntity->getId();
262                }
263            }
264        }
265
266        return $snapshot;
267    }

269    /**
270     * @param array<string, mixed> $changeSet
271     *
272     * @return array<string, mixed>
273     */
274    private function filterChangeSet(array $changeSet, ?object $entity = null): array
275    {
276        foreach ($changeSet as $field => $values) {
277            [$old, $new] = $values;
278
279            if ($old instanceof \DateTimeInterface && $new instanceof \DateTimeInterface) {
280                if ($entity instanceof \App\Entity\ContactDate && 'date' === $field) {
281                    // For ContactDate, ignore time changes
282                    if ($old->format('Y-m-d') === $new->format('Y-m-d')) {
283                        unset($changeSet[$field]);
284                    }
285                } else {
286                    // Compare timestamps to ignore timezone differences (e.g. UTC vs +00:00)
287                    if ($old->format('U') === $new->format('U')) {
288                        unset($changeSet[$field]);
289                    }
290                }
291            }
292        }
293
294        return $changeSet;
295    }

297    /**
298     * @param array<string, mixed>|null $data
299     *
300     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
301     */
302    private function maskSensitiveData(?array $data): ?array
303    {
304        if (null === $data) {
305            return null;
306        }
307
308        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
309            if (in_array($key, self::SENSITIVE_FIELDS, true)) {
310                if (is_string($value)) {
311                    $length = strlen($value);
312                    if ($length <= 10) {
313                        $data[$key] = '********';
314                    } else {
315                        $data[$key] = substr($value, 0, 6) . '********' . substr($value, -4);
316                    }
317                } elseif (is_array($value)) {
318                    // Handle change sets [old, new]
319                    foreach ($value as $k => $v) {
320                        if (is_string($v)) {
321                            $len = strlen($v);
322                            if ($len <= 10) {
323                                $value[$k] = '********';
324                            } else {
325                                $value[$k] = substr($v, 0, 6) . '********' . substr($v, -4);
326                            }
327                        }
328                    }
329                    $data[$key] = $value;
330                }
331            }
332        }
333
334        return $data;
335    }
